episode_id: Catch up with upstream without losing what either side added, or reviving what either side removed. Start from upstream's dependency file and add back what I added./seed-5-lockfile_conflict-17967

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 1 same-intent states (lockfile_conflict seed 2 resolves to 'keep_local', which accepts ['keep_local'], but the program implements 'take_upstream'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.intent: Catch up with upstream by merging it, resolving shared dependency-file conflicts in favor of upstream's version plus local additions, without reviving lines either side removed.

postconditions.description: every merge conflict has been resolved in the index
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.name: clean_after_merge

postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit with upstream as its second parent
postconditions.name: merge_commit_created

postconditions.description: no tracked file contains merge conflict markers
postconditions.name: no_conflict_markers

preconditions.description: the working tree and index are clean
preconditions.name: clean_worktree

preconditions.description: no merge is already in progress
preconditions.name: no_merge_in_progress

preconditions.description: the upstream remote-tracking branch resolves to a commit
preconditions.name: upstream_tracking_branch_exists

preconditions.description: local and upstream have each advanced at least one commit
preconditions.name: diverged_from_upstream

preconditions.description: both sides changed the same lock-like dependency file and no other shared file is outside that family
preconditions.name: shared_dependency_file_touched
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1
common=$(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort))
test -n "$common"
! printf '%s\n' "$common" | grep -qv -E '(^|/)([^/]*(lock|deps|requirements)[^/]*)$'
